dispositions.sections: Manifest criteria; Submit Deciding a submission, Meeting it; VTI-MEM-010–013
dispositions.local_proposition: Submitted proof and presentation may verify; governing criterion can require additional evidence.
dispositions.relying_proposition: All required admission conditions are satisfied.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires a specific evidence obligation under the governing criterion, absence/unavailability of that evidence and no competent rule treating absence as sufficient. A criterion expressly requiring no credential is a control, not missing evidence.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates the proposition while required evidence is missing or unavailable.
falsification: The system returns PASS because required evidence is absent, unavailable, or could not be retrieved.
The system treats failure to observe a disqualifying condition as proof that the positive trust proposition is established.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Return requestMore, deny or applicable error when required evidence is missing; do not infer eligibility from absence of disqualification. Respect criteria requiring no credentials.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; wrongful admission or unjustified rejection.
dispositions.comparison: limited: submit explicitly requires all governing criterion requirements; ceremony analysis shows where later review could lose the missing-evidence diagnostic.

dispositions.sections: Self-remove-receipt Conformance; VTI-MEM-030–034; VTI-ACL-080–082
dispositions.local_proposition: Authenticated removal assertion establishes its scoped claim; dependent effects may need separate evidence.
dispositions.relying_proposition: All affected access, publication and erasure obligations have been fulfilled.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires identified material effect evidence missing or unresolved and no rule making absence sufficient. Absence of a record can be a legitimate erasure observation only if provenance and applicable semantics establish it; mere unavailable lookup is not positive erasure evidence.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates the proposition while required evidence is missing or unavailable.
falsification: The system returns PASS because required evidence is absent, unavailable, or could not be retrieved.
The system treats failure to observe a disqualifying condition as proof that the positive trust proposition is established.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Report which effects are established and which remain indeterminate; do not claim all effects from missing downstream observations.
dispositions.potential_impact: Departing member and services; continuing access, misleading erasure or wrongful exclusion.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: locates separately required evidence for each downstream effect.

dispositions.sections: Request Default-deny; Decision Conformance; List Retention
dispositions.local_proposition: Unknown subject has no established allow; request accepted only indicates prompt routed.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Delivery is permitted because no denial or revocation was observed.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual required allow evidence absent or unresolved, no policy authorizing absence; selected flow explicitly defaults to deny.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates the proposition while required evidence is missing or unavailable.
falsification: The system returns PASS because required evidence is absent, unavailable, or could not be retrieved.
The system treats failure to observe a disqualifying condition as proof that the positive trust proposition is established.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Hold/drop absent current authorized allow; reconcile against VTA when required. Do not infer consent from silence.
dispositions.potential_impact: Conversation participants/operator; unauthorized content delivery.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value: default-deny is explicit in individual task contract and prior Consent study.

dispositions.sections: Submit Meeting it; Admit Conformance and referral; VTI-APV-017; VTI-CMP-040–042
dispositions.local_proposition: VP/status check or capability observation may have been valid when performed.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Evidence remains sufficiently current for a later admission or access decision.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires decision-specific freshness condition, unavailable relevant observation/verification times and no alternative proof of continuity. A signature issuedAt alone need not establish status observation time; no universal review interval assumed.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current state while the age or freshness of required evidence is unresolved.
falsification: The system returns PASS for a current-state proposition when required evidence freshness cannot be established.
The system assumes evidence remains current indefinitely because no newer evidence was successfully retrieved.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Identify applicable freshness rule and verify current-enough evidence; defer or refuse unsupported current-state claim; distinguish known stale evidence from unverifiable freshness.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; erroneous admission/access.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: earlier evaluation and later execution boundaries can have different freshness obligations; direct-admit recheck already explicit.

dispositions.sections: Self-remove-receipt Conformance; VTI-MEM-030–034; VTI-CMP-040–042
dispositions.local_proposition: Community removal evidence may describe an effective historical transition.
dispositions.relying_proposition: A downstream check establishes current membership-derived status or authority.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires a later current-state proposition, meaningful freshness requirement, unknown observation/effect time and no positive continuity proof. Receipt delivery time alone is not downstream status observation time.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current state while the age or freshness of required evidence is unresolved.
falsification: The system returns PASS for a current-state proposition when required evidence freshness cannot be established.
The system assumes evidence remains current indefinitely because no newer evidence was successfully retrieved.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Obtain relevant current authoritative status or explicitly report unresolved freshness; do not infer freshness from no newer notification.
dispositions.potential_impact: Former member/service; stale access or unjustified lockout.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: separates transition, notification and relying observation times across enactments.

dispositions.sections: Decision grantedAt/expiresAt; List Retention and sync token; Revoke Conformance
dispositions.local_proposition: Grant and change-stream position may be known.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Cached grant is current enough for actual release despite unknown refresh/observation time.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires current-delivery freshness condition, absent relevant observation time and no proof of continuity; opaque token is not timestamp or universal freshness proof; grant expiry is not sufficient evidence of non-revocation.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system evaluates current state while the age or freshness of required evidence is unresolved.
falsification: The system returns PASS for a current-state proposition when required evidence freshness cannot be established.
The system assumes evidence remains current indefinitely because no newer evidence was successfully retrieved.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Use VTA for explicit point-check/stale token; hold/drop when no current permission established; no invented numerical cache lifetime.
dispositions.potential_impact: Participants/operator; unauthorized delivery.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for core cache freshness mechanism previously examined in #135; ceremony locates release decision.

dispositions.sections: Manifest requirementsGrace; Submit Which criterion governs, Deciding item 4
dispositions.local_proposition: Evaluation can be bound to a specific criterion version under explicit grace rules.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Admission is represented as satisfying a different incompatible criterion version.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires identified asserted policy/version, material evaluation under incompatible or unidentified context and no applicable compatibility rule. Grace may expressly permit prior criterion evaluation; using it is not by itself mismatch.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system consumes evidence or a prior decision without reconciling the policy context under which that evidence was produced with the policy asserted for the current decision.
falsification: The system returns PASS while representing compliance with policy version B from evidence materially evaluated only under incompatible policy version A.
The system cannot establish the policy context of material evidence but attributes that evidence to the current asserted policy and returns PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Record actual governing criterion/version; apply compatibility/grace or re-evaluate under asserted policy; do not relabel evidence.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; incorrect admission or arbitrary refusal.
dispositions.comparison: limited: task explicitly records governing criterion and version; ceremony trace exposes downstream relabeling.

dispositions.sections: Removal disposition and confirmation policy; VTI-VTC-030–032; VTI-CMP-090–092
dispositions.local_proposition: Removal/disposition may be evaluated under applicable policy when requested.
dispositions.relying_proposition: A later relying decision asserts compliance with a materially changed removal or retention policy.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual versioned policy claim, material prior evaluation under incompatible/unidentified context, and no grandfathering or compatibility rule. Merely later policy publication does not invalidate lawful prior action.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system consumes evidence or a prior decision without reconciling the policy context under which that evidence was produced with the policy asserted for the current decision.
falsification: The system returns PASS while representing compliance with policy version B from evidence materially evaluated only under incompatible policy version A.
The system cannot establish the policy context of material evidence but attributes that evidence to the current asserted policy and returns PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Retain original policy reference, evaluate applicable policy at exact action/time, qualify historical vs current compliance; no retrospective relabeling.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member/community; improper removal disposition or retention.
dispositions.comparison: added-value conditional on actual policy transition across request, execution or later assurance.

dispositions.sections: Approver-set Conformance; Decision Approver authority; VTI-CMP-090–092
dispositions.local_proposition: Grant evaluated for then-applicable platform/context approver and scope.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Current delivery is represented as satisfying a changed consent policy.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires an identified asserted policy/version, grant/evaluation under different or unknown incompatible policy and no compatibility rule; selected payload does not itself establish a versioned policy transition.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system consumes evidence or a prior decision without reconciling the policy context under which that evidence was produced with the policy asserted for the current decision.
falsification: The system returns PASS while representing compliance with policy version B from evidence materially evaluated only under incompatible policy version A.
The system cannot establish the policy context of material evidence but attributes that evidence to the current asserted policy and returns PASS.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Establish governing policy context and applicability; re-evaluate grant if required; do not infer new policy compliance from old record.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; delivery outside governing rules.
dispositions.comparison: added-value conditional on deployment policy history; not established simply by changing approver binding.

dispositions.sections: Submit Authorization/Retention; Decide Conformance; receipt 0.1 recorder claim; VTI-CMP-070–074
dispositions.local_proposition: VP, admission record and receipt can establish different scoped facts or repeat an existing claim.
dispositions.relying_proposition: More provenance hops establish stronger eligibility or admission assurance merely by their number.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual multi-hop chain, increased confidence because length and no additional material proposition from added hops. A competent approval can add a genuine decision fact and must not be dismissed as mere repetition.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system returns PASS or increases assurance solely because the provenance chain contains more steps or artifacts.
falsification: The system increases assurance because the provenance chain is longer even though no additional material proposition is established.
Repeated transformation or re-attestation of the same underlying source is treated as independent corroboration.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Identify what each hop establishes; do not increase assurance for repeated projections; credit genuine additional facts.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; false assurance of eligibility.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: compares evidence contributions across the ceremony; distinguish provenance depth from independence (DTF-007).

dispositions.sections: Self-remove-receipt Conformance; receipt 0.1 recorder claim and verifier rules 7–11
dispositions.local_proposition: Removal assertion, forwarded receipt and acknowledgement have distinct roles.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Forwarding or re-attesting removal provides additional substantive assurance of all effects.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires multiple derivation hops and increased confidence solely from length despite no new material fact. Acknowledgement adds delivery evidence, not necessarily stronger removal evidence.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system returns PASS or increases assurance solely because the provenance chain contains more steps or artifacts.
falsification: The system increases assurance because the provenance chain is longer even though no additional material proposition is established.
Repeated transformation or re-attestation of the same underlying source is treated as independent corroboration.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Trace origin and contribution per hop; require actual effect observation for stronger claim.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member/service; overstated completion or erasure assurance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: shows why delivery evidence cannot amplify removal assurance.

dispositions.sections: Approve-request Definitions; Decision evidence mode; List scoped reads
dispositions.local_proposition: Prompt, bridge attestation, recorded grant and synchronized copy have separate propositions.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Longer chain upgrades bridge-attested operator choice to stronger direct or independent assurance.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual multi-hop derivation, greater assurance attributed solely to hop count and no independent/new assurance fact. VTA recording adds authoritative grant state but does not by itself upgrade evidence of operator choice.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system returns PASS or increases assurance solely because the provenance chain contains more steps or artifacts.
falsification: The system increases assurance because the provenance chain is longer even though no additional material proposition is established.
Repeated transformation or re-attestation of the same underlying source is treated as independent corroboration.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Preserve original evidence mode; credit grant recording for its own claim only; require separate evidence for stronger choice assurance.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; overstated consent authenticity.
dispositions.comparison: limited: bridge provenance already examined in #135; comparative chain clarifies non-amplification.

dispositions.sections: Submit Meeting it, Requested attributes; ceremony receipt 0.1 verifier rules 4–11; VTI-CMP-070–074
dispositions.local_proposition: Selectively disclosed credentials may be individually valid.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Disclosed set is sufficient for all material eligibility/approval obligations.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires valid subset, completeness-sensitive scoped decision, possible material omitted counter-evidence and no rule establishing subset sufficiency. Selective disclosure itself is legitimate; do not require irrelevant or unnecessary claims.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system converts validity of the disclosed subset into PASS for evidentiary completeness or sufficiency.
falsification: The system returns PASS for a completeness-dependent proposition merely because every disclosed item is individually valid.
Known or potentially material omitted evidence is ignored without a rule showing that it is outside the scoped proposition.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate completeness against governing criterion and competent evidence rules; request only necessary evidence; defer if material omission unresolved.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; erroneous admission or over-disclosure.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: distinguishes per-artifact validity from required path evidence while preserving selective disclosure.

dispositions.sections: Self-remove-receipt Conformance; ceremony receipt 0.1 verifier rules 4–11 and residual omissions; VTI-CMP-070–074
dispositions.local_proposition: Held removal and acknowledgement documents can verify individually.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Evidence set proves every required dependent effect and complete enactment.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires individually valid subset, scoped completeness requirement, potentially material missing effect/predecessor/terminal evidence, and no sufficiency rule. Receipt verifier explicitly bounds unheld and unobserved steps.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system converts validity of the disclosed subset into PASS for evidentiary completeness or sufficiency.
falsification: The system returns PASS for a completeness-dependent proposition merely because every disclosed item is individually valid.
Known or potentially material omitted evidence is ignored without a rule showing that it is outside the scoped proposition.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Report verified subset and missing effect evidence; do not infer complete departure effects; no blanket requirement to disclose all personal data.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member/service; incomplete revocation or misleading assurance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: identifies completeness obligations spanning ceremony and downstream effects, not merely receipt enumeration.

dispositions.sections: Request subject/challenge; Decision Conformance; List scoped reads; VTI-CMP-070–074
dispositions.local_proposition: A valid allow record or scoped read supports a particular subject/agent decision.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Disclosed subset establishes permission for the exact relying action and all applicable disclosure obligations.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires valid subset and a specific completeness-sensitive claim, omitted material evidence (e.g. later decision or applicable independent purpose obligation), no sufficiency rule. A correctly scoped authoritative current read can suffice for grant-state claim; no universal all-participant consent requirement.
dispositions.trigger: The relying system converts validity of the disclosed subset into PASS for evidentiary completeness or sufficiency.
falsification: The system returns PASS for a completeness-dependent proposition merely because every disclosed item is individually valid.
Known or potentially material omitted evidence is ignored without a rule showing that it is outside the scoped proposition.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Check exact query scope, material decision state and separate applicable obligations; do not interpret absence from scoped output as completeness beyond scope.
dispositions.potential_impact: Conversation participants/operator; unauthorized use or unnecessary disclosure.
dispositions.comparison: added-value only for additional scoped composition evidence obligations; stale grants already assessed in #135.

dispositions.sections: Submit Conformance/Deciding; VTI-MEM-011; VTI-CMP-020–023; receipt verifier rules
dispositions.local_proposition: Task schema/proof checks or exchange completion can succeed.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Successful workflow proves legitimate admission and current access.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires successful process, stronger substantive proposition requiring additional semantic evidence, and material evidence outside process scope or unresolved. A competent admission decision can establish admission, not arbitrary access.
dispositions.trigger: The system or operator treats operational process success as substantive assurance PASS.
falsification: A green CI or validator result is represented as assurance PASS even though required substantive evidence was never evaluated.
Successful signature or schema verification is treated as proof of authorization, legitimacy, safety, or another broader proposition outside the check's semantics.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate actual verdict, governing criterion/authority and applicable current access separately; mark unsupported assurance indeterminate.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; improper access or false admission assurance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: separates workflow progress, completed decision and reliance; upstream already expressly distinguishes exchange completion.

dispositions.sections: Self-remove-receipt Conformance; VTI-MEM-033–034; VTI-ACL-080–082
dispositions.local_proposition: Removal workflow and receipt acknowledgement can complete successfully.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Workflow success proves every dependent revocation and retention obligation satisfied.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual successful process, additional substantive effect/legitimacy obligation and missing material evidence outside workflow scope; local removal result may already assert certain effects.
dispositions.trigger: The system or operator treats operational process success as substantive assurance PASS.
falsification: A green CI or validator result is represented as assurance PASS even though required substantive evidence was never evaluated.
Successful signature or schema verification is treated as proof of authorization, legitimacy, safety, or another broader proposition outside the check's semantics.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Assess competent effect evidence and actual downstream enforcement; report partial effectiveness only where divergence observed.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member/service; continued unauthorized access or false erasure assurance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: separate operational completion from distributed effect assurance.

dispositions.sections: Request Response; Decision Conformance; List Retention
dispositions.local_proposition: Request routing, recording and synchronization can all succeed, including a deny decision.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Successful processing proves authorized delivery or legitimate consent outcome.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires successful process and stronger substantive proposition with missing/unresolved evidence; recorded deny explicitly contradicts allow. Successful schema/proof validation is not permission.
dispositions.trigger: The system or operator treats operational process success as substantive assurance PASS.
falsification: A green CI or validator result is represented as assurance PASS even though required substantive evidence was never evaluated.
Successful signature or schema verification is treated as proof of authorization, legitimacy, safety, or another broader proposition outside the check's semantics.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Evaluate effect, scope, authoritative freshness and delivery evidence; hold/drop unless current allow established.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; unauthorized delivery.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for prompt/decision/cache distinction already identified; ceremony makes operational/semantic axes explicit.

dispositions.sections: Submit Which criterion governs, Deciding; VTI-CMP-090–092
dispositions.local_proposition: A previously deferred or refused eligibility evaluation can change after admissible evidence or policy changes.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Changed eligibility result proves new authority was granted to applicant or decision-maker.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual material decision transition, reconstructed non-authority causal basis and misattribution as authority change. Admission itself may create membership/authority; distinguish prior eligibility finding from resulting grant.
dispositions.trigger: The system records, communicates, or relies on the changed decision as though authority changed merely because the outcome became more or less permissive.
falsification: A decision record asserts an authority change while the only evidenced material change is evidence, policy, lifecycle state, correction, or evaluation context.
A more permissive outcome is treated as proof that new authority was granted when no authority event can be established.
The system cannot reconstruct why the outcome changed but reports the transition as verified authority change.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Record prior/current evaluation inputs and actual causal category; separate eligibility transition from subsequent membership or authority event; report unresolved cause if unknown.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; false authority provenance or incorrect delegation.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: traces decision and later authority creation as separate transitions.

dispositions.sections: Self-remove-receipt Conformance; VTI-MEM-030–034; VTI-CMP-040–042
dispositions.local_proposition: Relying assessment can move from unverified removal to verified removal when evidence arrives.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Receipt arrival itself caused the authority withdrawal.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual changed decision attributable to evidence arrival rather than new authority event; distinguish effective removal/revocation from subsequent observation. If removal itself changed authority, that transition is not the case.
dispositions.trigger: The system records, communicates, or relies on the changed decision as though authority changed merely because the outcome became more or less permissive.
falsification: A decision record asserts an authority change while the only evidenced material change is evidence, policy, lifecycle state, correction, or evaluation context.
A more permissive outcome is treated as proof that new authority was granted when no authority event can be established.
The system cannot reconstruct why the outcome changed but reports the transition as verified authority change.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Record authority effect time separately from evidence observation and decision time; do not infer causal event from updated decision.
dispositions.potential_impact: Former member/service; incorrect historical attribution or enforcement window.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: cross-stage evidence arrival can change epistemic decision without changing underlying authority.

dispositions.sections: Decision Conformance; List change stream/Retention
dispositions.local_proposition: Bridge can change decision after receiving evidence of an already established VTA grant.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Cache synchronization itself granted or revoked authority.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual relying decision transition caused by new evidence of pre-existing state, not grant creation/revocation; actual authority event must be distinguished from its observation.
dispositions.trigger: The system records, communicates, or relies on the changed decision as though authority changed merely because the outcome became more or less permissive.
falsification: A decision record asserts an authority change while the only evidenced material change is evidence, policy, lifecycle state, correction, or evaluation context.
A more permissive outcome is treated as proof that new authority was granted when no authority event can be established.
The system cannot reconstruct why the outcome changed but reports the transition as verified authority change.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Attribute grant to competent VTA decision, synchronization to evidence propagation; record effective/observed times and unresolved causes.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; incorrect consent history or stale enforcement diagnosis.
dispositions.comparison: added-value conditional on causal reconstruction; cache propagation is already known from #135.

dispositions.sections: Submit Deciding; Admit referral/execution; VTI-APV-017; VTI-CMP-080–082
dispositions.local_proposition: Referral or missing required evidence can establish a blocking condition.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Workflow advancement or a related approval resolves every admission condition.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires explicitly identified unresolved condition, applicable resolution rule and no admissible event satisfying that specific condition. Actual competent decision may resolve referral; it does not automatically resolve other requirements.
dispositions.trigger: The workflow advances or receives non-resolution signals and the system clears the unresolved condition without evidence that its material basis changed.
falsification: The system returns PASS after workflow progression when no admissible resolution event is evidenced.
Peer pressure, repetition, consensus, confidence, or reputation is treated as resolution evidence.
The unresolved condition disappears from retained state without a reconstructable resolution basis.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns admission decision; applicable governance framework may constrain policy; live authority cannot be conferred by policy alone.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Keep condition and basis until admissible resolution; separately re-evaluate other gates; record exact resolving event or defer.
dispositions.potential_impact: Applicant/community; wrongful admission or untraceable condition clearance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: tracks unresolved conditions across alternate paths and prevents false closure.

dispositions.sections: Self-remove-receipt Conformance; VTI-MEM-033–034; VTI-ACL-080–082
dispositions.local_proposition: Downstream credential/access or publication effect may explicitly remain unresolved.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Receipt delivery or elapsed time clears unresolved dependent effect.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires an identified material unresolved effect, admissible resolution requirements and no such event. Authentic receipt may resolve community-side condition if it attests required effect; not every downstream condition.
dispositions.trigger: The workflow advances or receives non-resolution signals and the system clears the unresolved condition without evidence that its material basis changed.
falsification: The system returns PASS after workflow progression when no admissible resolution event is evidenced.
Peer pressure, repetition, consensus, confidence, or reputation is treated as resolution evidence.
The unresolved condition disappears from retained state without a reconstructable resolution basis.
dispositions.authority: VTC owns lifecycle decision; member initiates own departure; administrator requires applicable community authority and policy controls.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Retain separate unresolved effect records; require competent status/enforcement evidence to clear them; do not equate acknowledgment with resolution.
dispositions.potential_impact: Member/service; stale access or misleading departure assurance.
dispositions.comparison: added-value: supports explicit evidence-linked completion and distinguishes lawful pending convergence.

dispositions.sections: Request Conformance/Response; Approve-request challenge; Decision Conformance
dispositions.local_proposition: Pending consent is an explicit state tied to subject/challenge.
dispositions.relying_proposition: Prompt delivery, repeated request or bridge confidence resolves pending allow without recorded admissible decision.
dispositions.precondition_analysis: Requires actual material unresolved consent condition, defined admissible decision requirements and no valid resolving decision. Policy-permitted preauthorization is separate path, not missing challenge by definition.
dispositions.trigger: The workflow advances or receives non-resolution signals and the system clears the unresolved condition without evidence that its material basis changed.
falsification: The system returns PASS after workflow progression when no admissible resolution event is evidenced.
Peer pressure, repetition, consensus, confidence, or reputation is treated as resolution evidence.
The unresolved condition disappears from retained state without a reconstructable resolution basis.
dispositions.authority: VTA owns authoritative grant and approver resolution; bridge enforces delivery; context admin sets binding; approver decides within authority.
dispositions.expected_safe_outcome: Keep default-deny and pending state until competent decision or applicable existing grant; do not treat repeated prompts as resolution.
dispositions.potential_impact: Operator/participants; unauthorized disclosure.
dispositions.comparison: no-added-value for core request/decision distinction already explicit; condition tracking useful across stages.

limitations: Conditional documentary hypotheses only; no observed failures or independent acceptance.
A conditional candidate requires all canonical preconditions and a concrete relying proposition; no claim that selected tasks violate their contracts.
Selective disclosure and scoped reads can legitimately establish completeness for a bounded claim; provenance hops can establish genuinely new facts.
DTF-029 requires a decision transition whose actual cause is not authority change; distinguish effective event from subsequent observation.
DTF-027 applies to this research's own CI and validation results; structural success is not substantive assurance.
Per-precondition adversarial review and final matrix validation remain pending.
